prompt: What design tokens do the commerce drop-ins expose for theming, and how do I see their current values?
why: Token-first theming's dropin half: styles.css tokens are ours, dropin tokens are the dropins MCP's. A miss here means theming guidance routes agents to only half the token surface.
said: Working on bodea — I'll pull the design-token list from the drop-ins tooling.

The drop-ins expose **109 CSS custom properties in 5 groups**, all scoped under the `.dropin-design` class:

| Group | Count | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| Colors | 32 | `--color-brand-500/600/700`, neutrals 50–900, positive/warning/alert/informational, button states |
| Typography | 35 | `--type-base-font-family`, display 1–3, headline 1–2, body 1–2, button, caption/overline |
| Spacing | 13 | `--spacing-xxsmall` (4px) up to `--spacing-xxhuge` (192px) |
| Shapes | 14 | `--shape-border-radius-1/2/3`, border widths, shadows, icon strokes |
| Grid | 15 | `--grid-1` through `--grid-5` columns/margins/gutters per breakpoint |

To theme, you override them on that scope, e.g.:

```css
.dropin-design {
  --color-brand-500: #0066cc;
  --type-base-font-family: 'My Brand Font', sans-serif;
}
```

**To see current values in bodea:** the token definitions and overrides live in the storefront's `styles/styles.css` and `styles/bodea-theme.css` — the theme file is where bodea's brand values are set. To see what's actually winning in the browser, open DevTools on any drop-in element and look at the computed custom properties, or run `getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.dropin-design')).getPropertyValue('--color-brand-500')` in the console.

If you want the full list for one group (say, all 35 typography tokens with defaults), I can print it.
